newsitem.title: USA: CNN says Whitewater prosecutor to delay departure.
newsitem.headline: CNN says Whitewater prosecutor to delay departure.

text.p: Whitewater prosecutor Kenneth Starr, who had been expected to leave for another job, has decided to remain in charge of the investigation involving President and Mrs. Clinton, CNN reported on Friday.

Starr has decided to stay on "to retain the decision-making authority over this continuing investigation," CNN said, quoting unidentified sources in Starr's Washington office. An announcement by Pepperdine University last Monday that Starr would become dean of its law school had prompted speculation he was shifting jobs because he planned to file no charges against the Clintons.
